article_title: Artificial intelligence: Why firms are struggling to set prices

tasks.prompt: Why are AI companies and their customers struggling with pricing?
options: AI products have no operating costs
Usage, value and computing costs vary, making both charges and budgets difficult to predict
Every provider uses the same fixed price
Customers refuse to use paid AI features
tasks.correct_answer: Usage, value and computing costs vary, making both charges and budgets difficult to predict
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הקושי המרכזי הוא שהשימוש, הערך והעלות משתנים מאוד, ולכן קשה לספקים לתמחר וללקוחות לתכנן תקציב.

tasks.prompt: Why do leading AI firms offer paid versions of their systems?
options: To recoup heavy investment and charge for additional capabilities
To stop users from accessing coding tools
To replace all subscriptions with advertising
To make token use impossible to measure
tasks.correct_answer: To recoup heavy investment and charge for additional capabilities
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החברות השקיעו סכומים גדולים ורוצות להחזיר את ההשקעה באמצעות גרסאות בתשלום ותכונות נוספות.

tasks.prompt: What is a “token” in common usage-based AI pricing?
options: A company share
A fixed monthly salary
A unit of text processed by an AI model
A guarantee that the answer is correct
tasks.correct_answer: A unit of text processed by an AI model
tasks.explanation_hebrew: token הוא יחידת טקסט שהמודל מעבד, ומשמש לעיתים כבסיס לחיוב לפי שימוש.

tasks.prompt: Why can falling token prices still lead to a larger total AI bill?
options: Providers always double every invoice
Firms stop monitoring consumption
Cheaper units can encourage much greater use, especially by multi-step agents
Token prices determine employee salaries directly
tasks.correct_answer: Cheaper units can encourage much greater use, especially by multi-step agents
tasks.explanation_hebrew: גם כשמחיר היחידה יורד, צריכה מוגברת ותהליכים מרובי צעדים יכולים להעלות את ההוצאה הכוללת.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “recoup” mean?
options: Predict a future cost
Recover money that was invested or spent
Convert text into tokens
Hide a loss from shareholders
tasks.correct_answer: Recover money that was invested or spent
tasks.explanation_hebrew: recoup פירושו להשיב הוצאה או להחזיר כסף שהושקע.

tasks.prompt: If AI costs “balloon”, what has happened?
options: They have grown rapidly
They have become precisely predictable
They have been converted into shares
They have stopped changing
tasks.explanation_hebrew: balloon כפועל פירושו לגדול במהירות או לתפוח.

tasks.prompt: Explain the contrast between “plummeted”, “skyrocketed” and “variable” in the pricing discussion. Answer in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר ירידה חדה, עלייה חדה ושינוי לא קבוע, וליישם על מחיר יחידה לעומת צריכה או חשבון כולל.
expected_points: Variable means changing rather than fixed
A per-token price can fall while usage or total spending rises

tasks.prompt: Why might a predictable subscription price be attractive to a buyer but risky for an AI provider? Answer in 4–6 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג ודאות תקציבית ללקוח מול סיכון של שימוש כבד ועלויות חישוב לא צפויות לספק.
expected_points: A subscription gives the buyer budget certainty
Customers may use very different amounts of computing
Heavy users can cost the provider more than the fixed fee covers
The provider may need limits, tiers or usage charges

tasks.prompt: Write a 120–170 word summary comparing subscriptions, usage-based token pricing and bundles, and explain why none perfectly solves the AI pricing problem.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין ודאות, קשר לצריכה, מורכבות וערך; ולהזכיר השקעות, עלויות משתנות ולחץ לרווחיות.
expected_points: AI firms need to recoup large investments and satisfy shareholders
Subscriptions are predictable but may not reflect actual usage
Token pricing links charges to consumption but bills can be volatile and hard to understand
Bundles or tiers simplify purchasing but may still mismatch value and cost
Rapid changes in models, features and consumption make long-term pricing difficult

tasks.prompt: Recommend a pricing model for a company adopting AI coding agents, and defend it in 6–8 sentences using evidence from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לבחור מודל ברור, להתייחס לצריכה מרובת צעדים, ודאות תקציבית, מגבלות שימוש, ערך ובקרה על עלויות.
expected_points: State a clear recommendation such as a capped usage plan or tiered bundle
Explain that coding agents may consume many tokens across multiple steps
Include a spending cap or monitoring mechanism for predictability
Address the provider’s need to cover computing costs
Explain how the model connects price to business value
